user.title: Liiga Player Statistics
user.description:
The API URL, season year, and tournament phase (regular season / playoffs) are computed automatically from the current date. You only need to choose which stat categories to track and how many players to show per leaderboard.

Available categories: points, goals, assists, plusminus, powerplaygoals, shots, shotpercentage, xge, games, winninggoals

data.top_n: Number of players to show in each leaderboard
